refnamediv.refpurpose: Estimate the coherence of signals using the Welch method.

refsynopsisdiv.title: Syntax
refsynopsisdiv.synopsis: [Pxx, freq] = cohere(x, y, Nfft, Fs, window, overlap, range, plot_type, detrend)

listitem.para: Vectors. Input signals for coherence estimation.
Vector. Windowing function applied to each segment.
Integer. Number of overlapping samples between segments.
String. Frequency range for the analysis.
String. Type of plot to generate.
String. Method for removing trends from the data.
Vector. Frequency values corresponding to the coherence estimate.

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: This function estimates the coherence (mean square) of signals `x` and `y` using the Welch periodogram/FFT method. It is compatible with Matlab R11 `cohere` and earlier versions.
